title: Chapter 344 Who Is The Yellow Bird?
content:
Chapter 344 Who Is The Yellow Bird?

"Hmph, Shane, today is your death day." Kotaro gnashed his teeth and said viciously.

"A kid who hasn't even grown all his hair yet dares to speak so arrogantly." Shane, the giant hammer man, laughed nonchalantly, not taking Kotaro seriously at all.

He even put a giant hammer on the ground, took out another wine pot, and pretended to drink.

This action directly angered Kotaro.

Shane's purpose was obvious, which was to anger his opponent and lure Kotaro to attack.

Shane's physical strength was still consumed after a series of battles, especially when he used heavy weapons.

He was thinking about it.

The opponent would definitely think that he was exhausted after the battle and wanted to delay time to recover his physical strength and internal strength.

But Shane did the opposite and wanted to make a quick decision.

Kotaro swung his samurai sword and rushed up quickly.

Shane smiled, and the wine pot in his hand was not filled with wine at all, but a hidden weapon.

He pointed the mouth of the wine pot at Kotaro, triggered the mechanism, and hundreds of needles flew out in the blink of an eye.

Kotaro was accelerating and collided with the dense flying needles head-on.

Although he tried his best to swing the samurai sword, he was still stabbed by countless flying needles, especially on his face.

"Ah!"

Kotaro screamed.

His face immediately began to corrode.

Seeing this, Xie En did not hesitate to raise his hammer and was about to kill his opponent.

Kotaro had no choice but to run for his life.

Not long after running, something strange happened.

Xie En was covered by a big net and could not break free in a short time.

What's more amazing is that the black-clothed man who fell to the ground actually stood up and looked at the two of them.

Then he ran away.

Are they all so cunning?

This battle opened Wang Shuo's eyes!

These people are not easy to deal with!

They all used the common language of the North Sea Empire, and Wang Shuo could still barely understand it.

Coincidentally, the direction that the man in black fled was actually where Wang Shuo was hiding.

Wang Shuo was a little suspicious, did this guy find him?

I just want to watch the show, I don’t want to end it!

Do I have to be the oriole this time?

Wang Shuo thought to himself, if you really pass by me, don’t blame me for being rude.

As expected.

The man in black didn’t think too much and rushed over directly.

He was seriously injured, and he just held on just now, not wanting the other party to notice it.

If one of the two people wins, he will definitely come to chase him.

His sternum was broken, his internal organs were damaged, and he was already a little dizzy.

When he was less than 5 meters away from Wang Shuo, Wang Shuo used a move of "Iron Chain Binding" and a move of "Dragon Transformation Attack".

He was killed instantly.

Wang Shuo noticed at this time that there were no digitized numbers in this operation.

Naturally, there was no killing prompt.

Wang Shuo did not hesitate and went straight forward to pick up the spoils.

Two pieces of Shura Order and a long sword were searched from him.

"Poor bastard."

Wang Shuo's action directly alarmed Xiaotaro and Xie En in the distance.

Xiaotaro immediately stabbed Xie En with a samurai sword, trying to end the battle as soon as possible.

With a "puff", the long sword pierced Xie En's body.

There was no accident this time.

Xie En was killed, and the things on his body were also obtained by Xiaotaro.

Wang Shuo rushed over quickly.

"Hey, why don't you have martial ethics and take advantage of others' misfortune!"

At this time, Xiaotaro's face was severely corroded, and there were double images in his eyes.

Wang Shuo was shocked in his heart. He was really famous for his double standards.

No nonsense, after all, the opponent was also a high-level general, Wang Shuo was still quite careful.

Wang Shuo directly summoned a swamp under the opponent's feet, and then used control skills to lock it.

This set of operations is really useful.
